description: This file defines the interface for a ConnectorType class and a ConnectorController class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes external references to IIPCServer proxies, manages communication channels, and handles controller lifecycle management.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: Manages a singleton instance controlling a Core::IUnknown controller, providing methods to announce, revoke, and access the controller.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: A template class managing communication channels (Channel) for RPC connections, providing methods to acquire interfaces, access communicators, and manage operational state.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectorController.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Sets and adds reference to the controller object.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases and clears the controller object.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Returns the current controller object, adding a reference if not null.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Template method to acquire an interface of type INTERFACE via a communication channel.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the CommunicatorClient associated with a given node ID.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying IIPCServer engine.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Virtual method to set operational state, can be overridden.
